system.description:
Fire Release: Flame Armor · cast at C-Rank · no type

12 temporary hit points.

While you have them: wind damage can't take you below 1 of them, resistance to fire damage, immunity to Burned.

While you have them, melee attacks that strike you deal 12 fire damage to the attacker.
system.summary: 12 temporary hit points. While you have them: wind damage can't take you below 1 of them, resistance to fire damage, immunity to Burned. While you have them, melee attacks that strike you deal 12 fire damage to the attacker.

rules.text: The fire resistance and Burned immunity last only while you have temporary hit points from this jutsu: end the Amp when they're gone.
Wind damage can't reduce you below 1 temporary hit point from this jutsu.
Melee attacks that strike you deal 12 fire damage to the attacker.
